verdict.rationale: The only evidence of Fern's own public API is a probe finding a live OpenAPI spec at buildwithfern.com/openapi.json, which suggests a documented programmatic surface. The SDK and CLI generation, MCP server and llms.txt evidence covers customers' APIs or other agent channels, not a public API for driving Fern itself, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: first-party docs describing Fern's public API endpoints and operations, authentication details, evidence of which product actions (publish, deploy, manage docs) the API can drive, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://buildwithfern.com/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
